findings.title: No test pins the nearest-cent rounding
findings.detail: Dropping the + 50 term, so the total truncates instead of rounding, leaves go test ./cart/... green: every case is rounding-indifferent.
findings.risk_rationale: Every discounted order can be off by a cent with the suite still green.

findings.title: No test pins the line total's quantity factor
findings.detail: Dropping * it.Qty leaves go test ./cart/... green: every item in the tests has a quantity of one.
findings.risk_rationale: An order of several units of one item would be priced as one unit with the suite still green.

summary: The fix is right; two terms of the pricing path survive their mutants: the rounding and the quantity factor.
